purpose: Make 'trust us' unnecessary with a carefully scoped public scoreboard of engineering health.
template: Publish: canonical test status / replay determinism / known open invariants / recent falsifications / live vs experimental components / recovery drills / performance regressions / security findings after remediation. Hard scoping rule from the directive: no internal secrets, no credentials, no exploitable operational details. Each row cites its source and its freshness; a stale row is labeled stale, never silently left. The scoreboard earns trust by showing the current state including the open invariants, not by curating a green wall.
